gaps: None within 2021-2026 as published. CWPA posts no poll between the preseason and the Week 1 poll (e.g., 2024: Aug 21 preseason, then Sep 11 Week 1) — that is the release schedule, not a missing poll.
2026 season is in progress: polls through Week 4 (Sep 23, 2026) as of 2026-09-29.
Spring-2021 posts (the COVID-delayed 2020 men's season) are excluded; Biola men's water polo began fall 2021.
sources_tried: collegiatewaterpolo.org WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=varsity poll): CWPA weekly poll release posts; the national Top 20 (men) / Top 25 (women) table is the first table in each post
release_date = the CWPA post's publication date (polls are released Wednesdays ~6 pm ET; post date matches the date in each poll's title)
